'''Alyak''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fyodos]]. She was the wife of the [[Chief/Legends|chief]] of the [[Roh tribe]], [[Kalor (Fyodos)|Kalor]], and mother to [[Dubeh]] and [[Meerak]].
